quiz.prompt: Die Mitwirkenden in a film are…

goodToKnow: Die Mitwirkung is participation or cooperation: unter Mitwirkung von (with the participation of), the credits line in concerts and films. In official German, die Mitwirkungspflicht is a duty to cooperate: if you receive benefits from the Jobcenter or apply for asylum, you must provide documents and information. Mitwirken means to take part or contribute: an einem Projekt mitwirken. Die Mitwirkenden are the participants or cast.
